Splitting the nightly reconciliation job

Posted by the Platform team

Our nightly reconciliation job now regularly exceeds its 6-hour window — we’re splitting it into per-ledger workers so no single merchant’s volume can blow the whole batch’s budget. This isn’t a hypothetical: on three of the last five nights the job ran past 9am, delaying same-day settlement reports for merchants on the East Coast.

The fix, in short: shard by ledger id, run shards in parallel, and merge results at the end. It’s not glamorous work & it won’t show up in a changelog most customers read, but it buys us headroom for the next 12–18 months of growth.
